prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. TOP RIGHT — troop (v.成群结队地走动): A small group of friends troops together through a doorway in an informal close cluster, shared movement and no military uniforms.
BOTTOM LEFT — unsettle (v.使不安): An adult is disturbed while trying to work after hearing unexpected noise outside, turns anxiously toward the window.

CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: trembling hands reveal anxiety; informal group walks together; unexpected sound unsettles worker; runner mocked by jeering person. Correct bodily gestures, no severe anatomy flaws and safe cell separation.
